newsitem.title: INDIA: India cotton prices rise on news of quota hike.
newsitem.headline: India cotton prices rise on news of quota hike.

text.p: Indian cotton prices rose on Thursday on poor supply and reports that the government had allowed additional exports of 400,000 bales, traders said.
They said this would take the total export quota for the year to one million bales (170 kg each).

In spot deals, Bengal Desi rose by 20/30 rupees to 835/860 rupees per maund (ie. 37.32 Kg) and Punjab saw ginned rose by 15/30 rupees to 1,390/1,630 rupees per maund. Long staple Gujarat Sankar - 4 also rose by 400/500 rupees to 18,000/18,500 rupees per candy(355.56 Kg).
